jurisdictions.description: Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic with a parliamentary system of government.

jurisdictions.code_type: LGD State Code 27 / Census 2011 State Code 27
jurisdictions.description: Formed under the Bombay Reorganisation Act, 1960. Bicameral state legislature (Vidhan Sabha & Vidhan Parishad).
Revenue district in North Maharashtra (Khandesh/Nashik Administrative Division). Comprises 15 talukas, 2 municipal corporations, 6 municipal councils, and 8 nagar panchayats.
Includes Nashik Municipal Corporation urban territory and surrounding peri-urban gram panchayats.
Predominantly rural and tribal agro-hub sub-district in Nashik.
Intensive agricultural/grape cultivation taluka with major rural cooperative institutions.
Major textile weaving and urban cluster centered around Malegaon Municipal Corporation.
Industrial (MIDC) and rural hub southeast of Nashik city.
Governed under Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act, 1949. Responsible for 122 wards organized into 6 administrative divisions.
Apex 3-tier Panchayati Raj body under 73rd Constitutional Amendment & Maharashtra Act V of 1962, overseeing 15 Panchayat Samitis and 1,380+ Gram Panchayats.

institutions.official_name: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
institutions.mandate_summary: Policy formulation, devolution advocacy, capacity building for 3-tier Panchayati Raj Institutions under Part IX of the Constitution.

institutions.official_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
institutions.mandate_summary: Urban governance policy, national urban missions (AMRUT, Smart Cities, Swachh Bharat Urban), and urban local body reform guidelines.

institutions.official_name: Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Maharashtra
institutions.mandate_summary: Administration of Zilla Parishads, Panchayat Samitis, Gram Panchayats, rural sanitation, rural road connectivity, and rural employment schemes.

institutions.official_name: Urban Development Department (UDD-1 & UDD-2), Government of Maharashtra
institutions.mandate_summary: Oversight of Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, Town Planning, Development Control Regulations, and urban infrastructure subsidies.

institutions.official_name: Public Works Department (PWD), Government of Maharashtra - Nashik Circle
institutions.mandate_summary: Planning, construction, maintenance of State Highways, Major District Roads (MDR), and government office building complexes in Nashik district.

institutions.official_name: District Health Office (DHO), Nashik Zilla Parishad
institutions.mandate_summary: Delivery of primary healthcare via 100+ Primary Health Centres (PHCs) and sub-centres, maternal/child health, disease surveillance, and immunization in rural Nashik.

institutions.official_name: District Civil Hospital Nashik (Directorate of Health Services, Maharashtra)
institutions.mandate_summary: Secondary clinical healthcare, emergency trauma care, post-mortem, district medical certifications, and specialized inpatient care.

institutions.official_name: Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education - Nashik Divisional Board
institutions.mandate_summary: Conduct of SSC (10th) and HSC (12th) Board Examinations, examination center accreditation, paper custody integrity, and student grievance redressal.
Civic services inside Nashik city limits: urban water supply, underground drainage, solid waste management, city roads/bridges, streetlights, fire service, public gardens.

institutions.official_name: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL / Mahavitaran) - Nashik Zone
institutions.mandate_summary: Electricity distribution, transformer maintenance, streetlight feeder power, agricultural feeder separation, and billing grievance resolution.

institutions.official_name: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) - Regional Office Nashik
institutions.mandate_summary: Enforcement of Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act, Air Act, and Environment Protection Act; industrial effluent monitoring, Godavari river water quality tests.
Revenue administration, land records, disaster management coordination, inter-departmental grievance redressal (Aaple Sarkar / Lokshahi Din), law & order magistracy.

offices_and_roles.appointing_mechanism: Indian Administrative Service (IAS) cadre posting by General Administration Department, Government of Maharashtra
public_responsibilities: Head of revenue administration and district disaster management authority
Apex inter-departmental coordination and appellate authority for district grievances
Supervision of Sub-Divisional Magistrates and Tehsildars
offices_and_roles.holder_attribution_caveat: Role title verified; individual officer names change periodically via government transfers and must not be hardcoded as permanent service owners.

offices_and_roles.appointing_mechanism: IAS posting by Urban Development Department, Government of Maharashtra under Section 36 of MMC Act, 1949
public_responsibilities: Chief Executive Officer of Nashik Municipal Corporation
Implementation of Corporation resolutions and annual civic budget
Statutory custodian of municipal properties, water works, drainage, and city roads
offices_and_roles.holder_attribution_caveat: Executive statutory role verified from Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act, 1949.

offices_and_roles.role_name: Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Nashik Zilla Parishad
offices_and_roles.appointing_mechanism: IAS posting by Rural Development Department, Government of Maharashtra under Section 94 of Maharashtra Act V of 1962
public_responsibilities: Executive head of Zilla Parishad administration
Supervision of Block Development Officers (BDOs), District Health Officer (DHO), and Executive Engineers (Rural Water)
Implementation of rural development, health, and primary education schemes across 15 talukas
offices_and_roles.holder_attribution_caveat: Statutory role verified under Maharashtra Zilla Parishads & Panchayat Samitis Act, 1961.

offices_and_roles.appointing_mechanism: Maharashtra Engineering Services (MES) departmental appointment by Public Works Department
public_responsibilities: Maintenance, tender execution, and quality control of State Highways and Major District Roads
Pothole repair programs outside Municipal Corporation boundaries
Inspection of public bridges and road safety structures
offices_and_roles.holder_attribution_caveat: Departmental operational post verified from PWD administrative manual.

elected_offices_and_terms.office_title: Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha) - Nashik Parliamentary Constituency
elected_offices_and_terms.election_reference: General Election to Parliamentary Constituencies (18th Lok Sabha, 2024)
elected_offices_and_terms.service_boundary_caveat: Elected legislators represent citizen voices, deliberate legislation, and monitor MPLADS development funds. They do not hold statutory executive power to repair potholes or directly dispatch water tankers; complaints are legally routed to executive local bodies.

elected_offices_and_terms.office_title: Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha) - Dindori (ST) Parliamentary Constituency
elected_offices_and_terms.election_reference: General Election to Parliamentary Constituencies (18th Lok Sabha, 2024)
elected_offices_and_terms.service_boundary_caveat: Constituency covers northern talukas of Nashik district including Dindori, Kalwan, Surgana, Niphad, and Yeola.

elected_offices_and_terms.office_title: Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA) - Nashik Central Assembly Constituency
elected_offices_and_terms.service_boundary_caveat: MLAs represent constituents in the state legislature and committee oversight. Operational municipal maintenance rests with Nashik Municipal Corporation.

economic_records.entity_name: State of Maharashtra - Share in Central Taxes
economic_records.caveat: Calculated per the 15th Finance Commission formula (weightage on population, area, income distance, demographic performance, and forest/ecology).

economic_records.entity_name: Nashik Zilla Parishad - 15th Finance Commission Rural Grant Allocation
economic_records.caveat: Split 60:40 between Tied Grants (drinking water, rainwater harvesting, sanitation) and Untied Grants (location-specific basic community needs).

economic_records.entity_name: Nashik Municipal Corporation - 15th FC Urban Grant (Million-Plus Cities Challenge Fund)
economic_records.caveat: Tied to measurable improvements in air quality indicators and urban drinking water/sanitation service level benchmarks.

economic_records.entity_name: District Planning and Development Committee (DPDC), Nashik
economic_records.caveat: Chaired by District Guardian Minister. Funds distributed among tribal sub-plan, rural roads, public health infrastructure, and municipal development.
